title: Introduce structured logging in ChatServices with operator-focused diagnostics
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 10.1. ChatServices has no ILogger instrumentation. Inject logger(s), emit lifecycle/debug/failure breadcrumbs for provider calls, tool execution, context planning, and fallback paths, and verify logs are actionable without leaking sensitive payloads.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed structured lifecycle diagnostics in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` for operator-focused observability without prompt leakage: added context-plan preload/skip logs, Send/Stream lifecycle summaries, tool-loop iteration/limit/execution telemetry logs, and per-turn tool-limit truncation warnings. Added focused regression coverage in `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs` (`MemoryChatAgent_EmitsLifecycleLogs_WithoutLeakingUserPrompt`) to verify actionable log breadcrumbs are emitted and raw user prompt content is not logged. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~MemoryChatAgent_EmitsLifecycleLogs_WithoutLeakingUserPrompt|Name~MemoryChatAgent_ExecutesInterceptedToolCallsBeforeReturningReply|Name~MemoryChatAgent_StreamTraceShowsContextPlannerSkipReason"` (3/3 passed).

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Follow-up refinement: assigned stable `EventId` values for context-plan and tool-loop lifecycle diagnostics in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` (`42001`-`42012`) to support downstream filtering and alert routing without brittle message parsing. Extended `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs` logging test to assert these IDs (`42001`, `42006`, `42009`) are emitted while prompt content remains redacted from logs. Validation rerun: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~MemoryChatAgent_EmitsLifecycleLogs_WithoutLeakingUserPrompt|Name~MemoryChatAgent_ExecutesInterceptedToolCallsBeforeReturningReply|Name~MemoryChatAgent_StreamTraceShowsContextPlannerSkipReason"` (3/3 passed).
